entities.name: Lord of the Unreal

entities.name: Frost Titan
entities.description: A titan that breathes cold on its enemies, keeping them tapped.

events.summary: The amphin race is introduced as lanky, shrewd, partially aquatic humanoids.
events.quote: The amphin are a race of lanky, shrewd, partially aquatic humanoids who can dwell either in the briny depths or in the overgrown shallows.

events.summary: Rune-Scarred Demon tutors up a second Rune-Scarred Demon in a playtest.
events.quote: I think it was during an M12 Sealed playtest that I first saw a Rune-Scarred Demon tutor up another Rune-Scarred Demon

rejected.summary: The Pharaoh mummy punishes tomb interlopers and rises to take vengeance.
rejected.quote: he will whack the interloper (presumably some kind of tomb robber or over-curious archaeologist) and arise personally to inflict his vengeance
